mentions.name: Gmail fingerprint-based personal infographics generator
mentions.description: A privacy-focused personal tool that connects a Gmail account to an LLM capable of isolated code execution to generate infographics and charts about travel and spending. Emails are processed locally, while a powerful remote LLM generates queries blindly using only a schema and an anonymized 'fingerprint' file that hints at country, region, and interests without transmitting personal data.
mentions.audience: The author, for personal travel and spending analysis of their own Gmail account
mentions.source_excerpt: connecting my Gmail which is a source of truth for all financial, travel, personal related stuff to a LLM that can do isolated code execution to generate beautiful infographics, charts, etc. on my travels, spending patterns
